morph.use: a card or row grows into its screen

morphBack.use: the screen shrinks back into its card

pop.use: people, capsule buddies, badges and cards arriving (scale 0.3 to 1)

press.use: a pressed button springing back (pressed scale 0.94, 100 ms)

tabTrail.use: the tab disc's trailing edge, so the disc stretches on the way

dissolve.use: every screen part comes in and goes out through blur

frostedFirst.use: game cards and pictures appear as frosted glass, then resolve out of a 16 px blur

reduceMotion: nothing moves; parts appear at once
